Matches /workspace/.ruby-version (ruby-3.4.10) and .tool-versions (nodejs 24.9.0, yarn 4.13.0).

docker ps: workspace-apache-tika-1 (apache/tika:3.2.3.0-full) Up, port 9998; workspace-mailpit-1 (axllent/mailpit) Up (healthy), ports 1025/8025. ps aux shows postgres 14/main, foreman, puma 7.2.1 (tcp://localhost:3000), and vite node processes from /workspace.
curl http://localhost:3000/ -> '301 redirect: http://localhost:3000/users/sign-in'; curl http://localhost:3000/users/sign-in -> 200 (matches guide: app opens with sign-in).

Full authenticated login with documented credentials: GET sign-in to obtain csrf-token meta, then 'POST /users/sign-in' with user[email]=admin@example.org & user[password]=TTOF3UHA0bsQ -> '302 redirect: http://localhost:3000/'; subsequent 'GET /' -> 200 (no redirect); 'GET /api/users/info' -> 200 {"count_undone_notifications":10,...}.

Database (PGPASSWORD=samarbeid psql -h localhost -U samarbeid -d samarbeid_development): 'SELECT count(*) FROM users' -> 1; users.role for admin@example.org -> 2; 'grep enum role app/models/user.rb' -> {user:0, team_admin:1, super_admin:2}, i.e. seeded user is super_admin. Schema migrated (search_documents, good_jobs, menu_entries, news, tasks, groups, notifications, pages, settings tables all present and queried successfully in logs).
'bundle exec rails runner' (with APP_DB_* env vars) -> 'Rails 8.1.3.1 env=development; users=1; admin_role=super_admin'.
Frontend: served HTML references /vite-dev/@vite/client, /vite-dev/entrypoints/application.js, /vite-dev/entrypoints/vue.js; all three return 200 text/javascript via Rails :3000 and Vite :3036.

/tmp/dev/server.log shows successful seeding (ReindexJob created SearchDocument for user-1 admin@example.org; ImportRssFeedJob created news; GoodJob ran DeliverRecentNotificationsMailsJob) and many 'Completed 200 OK' requests. Only logged exceptions are routing errors from my own incorrect probe POSTs to /users/sign_in (correct route is dashed, per config/routes.rb).
assessment_summary: I validated the installation against the guide's success criteria: (1) requirements met, (2) http://localhost:3000 shows the local app, (3) an initial admin account exists and works. I inspected /workspace (Gemfile.lock, .yarn, node_modules, log/, config/database.yml present), confirmed installed tool versions match .ruby-version (ruby-3.4.10) and .tool-versions (nodejs 24.9.0, yarn 4.13.0), verified PostgreSQL 14 is running with the seeded samarbeid_development database, and confirmed Docker Compose services (tika:9998, mailpit:1025/8025) are up and healthy. Process inspection showed foreman + puma on :3000 and Vite on :3036, started by bin/dev as documented, with APP_DB_* env wiring to localhost PostgreSQL (idle collaboration connections visible in ps output). I then tested actual behavior: the root redirects to /users/sign-in (200), and a full login round-trip using the documented credentials admin@example.org / TTOF3UHA0bsQ succeeded (302 to /, then 200 home and 200 /api/users/info), proving authentication, sessions, and API work. The DB check confirms exactly one user with role super_admin, consistent with bin/setup's seeding; rails runner confirms Rails 8.1.3.1 in development with working DB access. Vite entrypoints serve with 200 through the /vite-dev proxy, confirming the Vue SPA is wired to the running dev server. Log review shows successful seed jobs and only benign exceptions (caused by my own malformed probe POSTs). Limitations: I could not visually render the Vue UI (no browser), so frontend interactivity beyond asset serving is untested; the admin password in the summary was trusted and then proven correct by a live login. No repair, migration, or configuration work was needed or performed.
